author: everestmcarthur
install_msg:
Thanks for installing **Wormhole v4.0.0** — the ultimate cross-server relay!

Get started: `[p]wh create <network-name>` then `[p]wh open <network-name>` in channels you want to link.

**v4.0.0 — Full Refactor:**
• Modular architecture: models, commands, listeners, services, UI all in separate files
• Per-network hierarchical staff system: Owner → Admin → Moderator → Helper → Member
• Enhanced moderation: server ban/mute, allowlist, purge, mod edit/nuke, anti-raid
• All 100+ commands work as both prefix and slash commands
• Full relay pipeline with emoji resolution, reply jump buttons, starboard, karma

Full help: `[p]wh help` or `/wh help`
name: Wormhole
short: The ultimate cross-server relay — modular architecture, hierarchical staff, 100+ hybrid commands.
description: Wormhole v4.0.0 is a fully modular cross-server relay cog for Red-DiscordBot. Features: real-time message relay (webhooks/embeds/compact), hierarchical per-network staff system (Owner/Admin/Moderator/Helper), edit/delete/reaction/reply/sticker/pin/typing sync, bidirectional DM relay, advanced auto-moderation (spam/raid/invite/caps/zalgo/mention-spam), granular mention policy (per-network + per-server + per-user), Terms of Service acceptance gate, user report system, context menu actions, cross-network starboard, karma system, keyword highlights, invite codes with vanity URLs, announcements, portal embeds, user profiles, backup/restore, blackout scheduling, anonymous mode, network-wide polls, AFK system, auto-responses, ephemeral messages, analytics dashboard, health monitoring, message bookmarks, user colours, quiet hours, network bridging/mirroring, emoji relay for foreign servers, and much more.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs, guild IDs, and channel IDs for relay functionality. Per-user data includes message counts, karma scores, keyword highlights, DM relay subscriptions, bookmarks, AFK status, ignore lists, colour preferences, quiet hour settings, analytics counters, ToS acceptance timestamps, and report records.
